title: 比特币8.3万：OKX总裁称不是好买点，跌破7万才加大定投？
speaker: Gracie Chen

segments.en: Okay, you're saying that you would only probably start looking into buying Bitcoin again if it falls to around 50,000. Tell us why that sort of threshold. And if I were to build some sort of crypto portfolio, what would that be right now? What would that look like?
segments.zh: 你说过，可能只有比特币跌到5万附近才会考虑再次配置。为什么是这个门槛？如果现在要构建加密资产组合，应该是什么样？

segments.en: So yes, I said below 60K. And that was said a couple of months ago. And indeed after what I said, I said what I said, Bitcoin did for below 60K. And I think that that is indeed a good price point to build your Bitcoin portfolio.
segments.zh: 是的，我说过6万以下，那是几个月前说的。之后比特币确实跌破6万。我认为那确实是构建比特币仓位的好价格点。

segments.en: Right now, given Bitcoin's price is around 83K today. So maybe if you have, it already depends on the user or the investor's portfolio. If you have no Bitcoin in your portfolio, but you're looking to continue buying some, doing dollar cost averaging is a smart strategy from 70K to 80K or even 83K as the current price. It's a good starting point if you have no portfolio.
segments.zh: 现在比特币价格约8.3万。这取决于用户或配置者的仓位。如果还没有比特币，想继续买入，从7万到8万甚至当前8.3万做定投是聪明策略。没有仓位的话，这是不错的起点。

segments.en: But if you have a little bit already, I think this is the kind of price that you can continue monitoring. And if you have a lot or even if you are fully allocated, again, this is, I don't think this is the time to sell, nor a good price point to continue buying.
segments.zh: 如果已有一点仓位，这个价格可以继续观察。如果仓位很重甚至满仓，我认为现在不是卖出时机，也不是继续买入的好价格点。

segments.en: But if it falls below 73K or 70K-ish, I think it's a good price point to purchase some Bitcoin or do more dollar cost averaging. But that's given you have a rather small portfolio in your Bitcoin allocation.
segments.zh: 但如果跌破7.3万或7万左右，我认为是买入一些比特币或加大定投的好价格点。前提是你的比特币配置比例还比较小。
